method: Nearest-rank percentiles; uncached Vitest Duration and node:test # duration_ms only. Cached replay durations excluded. Vitest setup is summed across workers, not wall time. Nx nested invocations produce multiple cache summaries. Job times from GitHub API; run total createdAt→updatedAt includes queue/orchestration. Runner minutes=sum actual job wall, not rounded billing.

runs.note: First merged-coverage run: per-task wall seconds of <project>:test:coverage from run-command summaries seed coverageRanking (single observation each). app-vue halves (2.9s + 5.2s, threshold-failed when file-sharded) sum to the 8.1s whole-suite estimate; app-vue is unsplittable in coverage mode. Unit jobs 2/3 failed on the app-vue threshold split; all other coverage tasks succeeded.
